notes.title: QUACKER BROS: FIRST HEIST JOINS THE BULLET HEAVEN 2.0 FEST!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107244/1c04f85864fd3ad6f965eb5239e150fa3e202697.png[/img]
First off, we'd like to announce that we're part of [b]Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0![/b] BHF is an annual event that celebrates the newly formed sub-genre on Steam called "Bullet Heaven."

And we have some news that we'd like to tell you ⏬

[h2]QUACKER BROS: FIRST HEIST NEW PATCH[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107244/9c04b388fb67d4da57cae51270bbacac87418ea5.jpg[/img]
We’ve released a balancing update for Quacker Bros: First Heist! 🛠 This update focuses on fine-tuning the gameplay with unit adjustments, tougher enemies, and reworked economy and payday balancing! 💸

You can read more information here :
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3103830/view/4469355336712586802

[h2]QUACKER BROS IS IN DEVELOPMENT[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107244/d397212cb0ab57bc391b12017a1358ad9def8916.png[/img]
As you know, Quacker Bros: First Heist is a free game you can enjoy, but it has limited features and plenty of room for improvement... and that’s the exciting part! 🎮

We’re hard at work on the full version of Quacker Bros, packed with even more fun and chaos! 🦆✨ Don’t forget to wishlist the game using the link below so you’ll be the first to know when it’s ready!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344970/Quacker_Bros/

That’s all for now! Don’t forget to follow us on social media below for more updates and daily interactions. 🦆✨ Enjoy the festival, everyone, have fun and quack on! 💥

notes.title: BALANCING UPDATE 🦆🛠
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107244/778b2fb3f726c924b599d8a7b40dc362f3d39aa3.jpg[/img]

After lots of hard work and amazing feedback from our players, we've made updates to improve the demo and create a smoother, more seamless experience! 🛠
Check out the changes and fixes below:

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Rebalanced Duck Power[/b] – as all things should be! 🦆💥
[*] [b]Increased gameplay difficulty[/b] toward the end for a greater challenge. 📈
[*] [b]Chickens are now bulkier.[/b] 💪🏼🐔
[*] Elite Chickens spawn more frequently. 🐔📈
[*] Adjusted the XP bar for higher levels, making it tougher to level up. 🔵
[*] Reworked the economy—more fortune to heist! 💰💎
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107244/0aa3c7f2ac0e1e2b0eb808d28dbf0c630dc8dabd.gif[/img]

If you have any question or thoughts, feel free to comment down below!

Sincerely,
[b]The Reima Project Team[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Jul 30 2024
notes.content:
Hi Quackers!

We have addressed some bugs and improvements for this day one patch.
Here are the details :

[list]
[*] Pressing spacebar (Halt) will highlight the ducks on the map
[*] Better text detail for purchasing units, now any ducks you don't have will be shown as "New"
[*] Various text improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

Enjoy!
